claim: On a real Android logcat capture, the tier-0 companion answered 5 of 8 key=value questions per window deterministically and correctly on every seed, making it more accurate than the 1.5B model alone on every seed with 2.67-2.86x fewer large-model tokens; exact dedup removed at most 8% of lines.
limits: One log, one device, one model; conflict questions ill-posed on logcat and not scored; questions built by the same key=value reader the lookup tier uses.
